Name: Beehouse Config Extensions
Author: MoorTarPetal
TagLine: Add more granular config to your beehouse mods!
Description:
OBJECTS
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.MinCount" - Minimum number of flowers required to flavor a honey (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BasePrice" - The base price of the before adding flower (Default: [Honey price])
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.Multiplier" - The multiplier added to the ingredient price (Default: 2.0)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BushStack" - How many flowers a bush of this items counts for (Default: 5)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.MaxDistance" - Maximum distance from the behouse the flower can be to be picked up (Default: 999)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.AltOutput" - The alternative item to hony this flower can produce
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.AltChance - The chance of producing the alternicte item (Deafult: 1.0)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.Override - Whether the flower is chosen (if it passes) no matter what (Deafult: false)

MACHINES
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.Radius" - The radius of the machine's scan area (Default: 5)

FRUIT TREES
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BlossomId" - The flower Id of the tree's blossom (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BlossomSeason" - The season for when the blossomId is available (Default "spring")
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BlossomCount" - How many flowers one tree counts for (Default: 1)

WILD TREES
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BlossomId" - The flower Id of the tree's blossom (Required)
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BlossomSeason" - The season for when the blossomId is available (Default "spring")
"MoorTarPetal.BeehouseConfigExtensions.BlossomCount" - How many flowers one tree counts for (Default: 1)
